'''Clan Ironstone''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] clan. The clan was wiped out<ref name="The Final Blade" /> by [[3625 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> as a result of an [[Altercation between Clan Mettir and Clan Ironstone|altercation]] between [[Clan Mettir]] and Clan Ironstone.<ref name="The Final Blade" />
